headline: DBS Expands Digital Payment Offerings with PayLah!
summary: DBS is expanding its PayLah! digital payment platform to provide additional payment methods and personalized customer experiences across generations.
why: Digital banking innovation and mobile wallet adoption strengthen customer retention and fee-based revenue streams for major retail financial institutions.
